item.title: What to Expect From Today's US Jobs Report
item.description: Isabelle Mateos y Lago, group chief economist at BNP Paribas, discusses the outlook for today's US jobs report and the potential consequences for Federal Reserve policy. "More important than the exact print is what's happening to the unemployment rate," Mateos y Lago tells Bloomberg Television. "We're expecting a further decline to 4.1%, and I think that's the the important metric for the Fed to look at in terms of the risk of second round effects." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Man Group Found Liable by Judge for ‘Breathtaking’ Kuwaiti Bribery
item.description: Man Group Plc’s shares fell after a judge ruled it could have to pay around $155 million for its role in “corruption on a breathtaking scale” that siphoned $1 billion from a Kuwaiti state-run pension fund over decades.
